stages.effectText: Damage dealt to enemies under an Elemental Burst effect increased to 110%
Whenever Burn burst is triggered on an enemy, immediately deals 390% ATK as Elemental Damage to that enemy, recovers HP equal to 12% of Max HP, and ATK +5% for 10s
Whenever Burn burst is triggered on an enemy, immediately deals 420% ATK as Elemental Damage to that enemy, recovers HP equal to 15% of Max HP, and ATK +10% for 10s
When an enemy within Attack Range is suffering an Elemental burst, SP recovery +0.2 per second

When defeated, falls to the ground and gains a 6000-point Barrier. While down, cannot attack or be healed, restores 4% HP per second, and each time she is attacked deals Arts damage equal to 100% of Blaze the Igniting Spark’s ATK and Burn equal to 20% of the Arts damage dealt to the attacker. Revives at full HP, inflicts Stun on nearby enemies for 5 seconds, and restores 4 SP to herself

When defeated, falls to the ground and gains a 6000-point Barrier. While down, cannot attack or be healed, restores 4% HP per second, and each time she is attacked deals Arts damage equal to 120% of Blaze the Igniting Spark’s ATK and Burn equal to 30% of the Arts damage dealt to the attacker. Revives at full HP, inflicts Stun on nearby enemies for 5 seconds, and restores 8 SP to herself
